findings.title: The server lets a role without permission: list another rep's activities by filter
preconditions: Signed in as the Rep test account of tenant A with an API token.
The resource addressed belongs to the same tenant.
reproduction_steps: Send GET /api/activities?rep_id=:other_rep directly to the API with the rep token (resolved request: GET /api/activities?rep_id=6).
Read the status and the body.
Check whether the protected data is present, and whether the database changed.
findings.actual_result: allowed (HTTP 200) (2 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)
findings.security_impact: A role can read data the permission model denies it. The restriction exists in the interface but is not enforced by the server.
findings.business_impact: Staff can see colleagues' accounts and pipeline, which undermines territory ownership and commission integrity, and breaks the access promises made to the customer.

history.note: All 2 originally failing check(s) were re-executed against build c4b1536f2ad5 and now pass.

findings.title: An API token is still accepted after the user's credentials are revoked
preconditions: Executive test account of tenant A holds a browser session and an API token, both working.
reproduction_steps: Sign in to obtain a browser session.
Request an API token for the same account.
Confirm both credentials are accepted.
Call the revoke-all-credentials endpoint from the browser session.
Reuse the browser session and the API token.
findings.expected_result: HTTP 401 with the revoked API token
findings.actual_result: revoke HTTP 200, token then HTTP 200 (16 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)
findings.security_impact: A credential remains usable after the point at which the system says it has ended.
findings.business_impact: Access cannot be reliably withdrawn from a departing employee, a lost device or a leaked credential.

findings.title: A user of one tenant can read another tenant's data through GET /api/referral-sources/:id
preconditions: Signed in as the executive test account of tenant A.
Identifiers of tenant B records are known to the caller (identifiers are sequential integers).
reproduction_steps: Obtain an API token as the executive of tenant A.
GET /api/referral-sources/51 (Referral source detail by foreign id; vector: url-path-id).
Inspect the response for records whose tenant is the victim tenant.
findings.expected_result: no victim-tenant data in the response
findings.actual_result: HTTP 200; response contains victim-tenant data (25 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)
findings.security_impact: An authenticated user of one tenant can read records that belong to a different tenant by changing an identifier.
findings.business_impact: One customer can see another customer's commercial relationships. This is a reportable breach of tenant confidentiality and of the customer contract.

findings.title: Patient work queued while the module was ON is executed after the module is switched OFF
preconditions: patient_module is OFF at the start and at the end.
An executive test account of the tenant.
reproduction_steps: Switch patient_module ON.
POST /api/jobs/patient-sync as the executive; note the queue item id.
Switch patient_module OFF.
Run the patient-projection-queue worker.
Read the queue item and the patient projection table from the database.
findings.expected_result: queued item not processed; no patient projection written while the flag is OFF
findings.actual_result: queue item done (PROJECTED); 1 projection(s) written; worker run succeeded
findings.security_impact: Functionality behind a disabled feature flag is reachable or executes. For a module that is switched off because it is not yet approved to hold regulated data, the switch is the control.
findings.business_impact: The business cannot state that the unapproved module is inert in production, which is the basis on which the release is being approved.

findings.title: The monthly report attributes activities to the wrong period
preconditions: Signed in as an executive of tenant A; every role with report access sees the same figures.
reproduction_steps: GET /api/reports/monthly?from=2026-07-01&to=2026-09-30.
Read the tenant's activities rows directly from the database.
Count rows whose activity_date date falls in the range, bucketed by month using the same activity_date date.
Compare each displayed figure with the recalculated one.
findings.expected_result: every activities/visits/calls/notes figure equals the count of source rows attributed by activity_date, 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 inclusive
findings.actual_result: 16 figure(s) differ; e.g. activities for 2026-07: displayed 295, expected 304 (difference -9) (10 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)
findings.security_impact: No confidentiality impact: a reported figure does not match the records it is calculated from.
findings.business_impact: Managers act on wrong numbers. Activity credited to the wrong period distorts performance reviews, targets and commission.
